title: EDG Community Update: Jan 3rd, 2022
body:
**Highlights**
- [Kabocha’s governance platform](https://twitter.com/HeyKabocha/status/1479373700394856449?s=20) powered by OpenSquare is now live.
- [The crowdloan waitlist](https://kabocha.network/) is open for Kabocha.
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases) to proceed further with the ERUP4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance. The core community dev Ramsey recently shared [the docker image for v3.3.3 aka ERUP4/Wako upgrade](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1438226365833175048?s=20) to save the compiling hustle for node/validator owners.
- Get to know more technical oriented updates on the ‘[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-jan-2nd/)’.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- [OnFinality’s platform release(#20)](https://twitter.com/OnFinality/status/1480449359649325056?s=20) brings massive functionality upgrades which include new features like version selection, option to deactivate flag type arguments, override system-generated arguments and improved node action menus.
- 4thPillarTech released their [revamped roadmap](https://twitter.com/4thtechProject/status/1479407175072194560?s=20).
- Community Treasury-funded Web3 Media platform, [New-Futures have opened up pre-registrations](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1469353591433478150?s=20) for their highly anticipated upcoming launch.
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.


**Governance**
- No active referendum. Upcoming proposal: [GMI it in crypto media](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1135-how-to-make-it-in-crypto-media-an-original-podcast-series/).
